description: `platform.status` when the platform is half-broken (S54 T2): a subsystem refusing is a STATE the panel carries, not a failed read of the platform — the door answers 200 and each block says its own truth. Retrieval's read refused, so its block is error with the source's own sentence riding VERBATIM (paraphrase would be a second voice, O3's rule inverted); the graph block is unwired — the seam is absent on this daemon, which is a different fact from broken and gets a different word; usage remains available, its partial cost riding with the floor as the store said it (three cost states, S33, never a fabricated figure). The panel never hides a half-refusing subsystem behind the blocks that answered.
